Fields.Name: Time Zone Start Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour at which this time zone starts (5.75 = 5:45). The zone runs until the next row's start hour (row 6 until row 0's) and may cross midnight.

Fields.Name: Cutscene Hour
Fields.Description: Hour of day shown during a cutscene that uses this time zone (18 = 18:00). The world's time of day uses this hour while the cutscene plays; the in-game clock itself is not changed.
